extDescription.message: Tells you if a Brazilian site is a scam, and why.

summary_baixo_risco.message: No risk signals in the checks below.

summary_atencao.message: A few signals deserve attention before you continue.

summary_alto_risco.message: Serious risk signals. Only continue if you're sure who's on the other side.

summary_muito_alto_risco.message: Several strong scam signals. Don't pay or share your details.

summary_nao_verificado.message: No check returned any data. That does not mean the site is safe.

reason_blocklist.message: This hostname appears in the PhishDestroy phishing list.

reason_pix_personal.message: The payment goes to a person, not the company.

reason_pix_wrong_cnpj.message: The payment goes to a different company than the one on the site.

reason_cnpj_inactive.message: The company's tax ID is not active.

reason_no_cnpj.message: The site shows no tax ID — normal for sites that don't sell directly.

reason_no_cnpj_with_payment.message: The site asks for a Pix payment but won't say which company receives it.

reason_cnpj_active.message: Tax ID active with the federal revenue service.

reason_domain_new.message: This site was created less than 30 days ago.

reason_domain_young.message: This site was created less than 3 months ago.

reason_domain_recent.message: This site was created less than 6 months ago.

reason_domain_under_year.message: This site was created less than a year ago.

reason_no_track_record.message: A recent site with nothing to vouch for it: not popular, not old, and no active company registration.

reason_brand_lookalike.message: The address uses a well-known brand's name but isn't its official site.

reason_brand_lookalike_named.message: The address uses the name {brand} but isn't its official site.

reason_brand_typosquat.message: The address imitates a well-known brand's name with one letter changed.

reason_brand_typosquat_named.message: The address imitates the name {brand} with one letter changed.

reason_brand_typosquat_old.message: The address resembles a well-known brand's, but it has existed for years.

reason_brand_typosquat_old_named.message: The address resembles {brand}, but it has existed for years.

reason_punycode.message: The address uses special characters that can pass for ordinary letters.

reason_ip_host.message: The address is an IP number, not a site name.

reason_shared_hosting.message: The page is on a free platform where anyone can create a site in minutes.

reason_shared_hosting_named.message: The page is on a free platform ({platform}) where anyone can create a site in minutes. The platform's age doesn't count for the page.

reason_suspicious_keywords.message: The address contains words common in scams (offer, withdrawal, tracking, unlock…).

reason_combo_brand_new.message: Aggravating: an imitated brand on a freshly created address.

reason_combo_brand_hosting.message: Aggravating: an imitated brand on a free platform.

reason_combo_brand_bait.message: Aggravating: an imitated brand together with bait words.

reason_combo_cheap_new.message: Aggravating: a cheap address (.shop, .xyz…) created recently.

reason_cnae_mismatch.message: The company is registered under a different business activity.

reason_registrant_mismatch.message: The site is registered under a different name.

reason_contact_only_whatsapp.message: The only contact is WhatsApp or a free email address.

reason_cheap_tld_private_whois.message: This kind of address (.shop, .xyz) is common in scams.

reason_broken_social_links.message: The social media links don't work.

reason_tranco_top100k.message: It's among the 100,000 most visited sites in the world (Tranco list).

reason_domain_established.message: Domain registered more than five years ago.

reason_domain_mature.message: Domain registered more than two years ago.

reason_official_domain.message: This is a well-known brand's official site.

reason_restricted_tld.message: The address ends in a restricted domain (.gov.br, .jus.br, .b.br…) that only verified bodies and institutions can register.

reason_marketplace_notice.message: This analysis covers the seller, not the marketplace itself.

footer_disclaimer.message: This is an automated analysis. When in doubt, don't pay.

popup_no_page.message: Open a site to see the analysis.

check_site_skipped.message: not needed, you supplied the data

check_domain_unknown.message: age not available for this domain

check_blocklist_unavailable.message: The phishing list could not be checked.

check_blocklist_clean.message: This hostname is not in this list. This does not guarantee safety.

check_failed_rate_limited.message: too many lookups, try again in a minute

pix_key_cpf.message: pays an individual, not a company

pix_key_phone.message: pays a phone number, not a company

pix_key_email.message: pays an email address, not a company

pix_key_random.message: random key, doesn't say who receives

transport_rate_limited.message: You've run too many lookups in a row. Wait a minute and try again.

transport_offline.message: We couldn't reach our server. Check your connection and try again.

transport_degraded.message: Some of the checks failed, so this result is incomplete.

error_unsupported_scheme.message: We can only check http and https links.

error_no_tld.message: Paste a valid link, like shop.com.br.

error_url_has_credentials.message: That link embeds a username and password. Paste just the site address.

error_invalid_cnpj.message: That tax ID isn't valid. Check the digits.

check_blocklist_stale.message: The cached list expired and its refresh failed. Check unavailable.

check_blocklist_listed.message: This hostname appears in the phishing list.

check_popularity_top.message: Among the 100,000 most visited sites in the world · Tranco

check_popularity_not_top.message: Not among the 100,000 most visited sites · Tranco. That alone doesn't indicate risk.

check_popularity_unavailable.message: Couldn't check the Tranco list right now.

check_popularity_shared.message: Not applicable: the popularity would be the platform's, not this page's.

check_domain_shared.message: {platform} · shared platform, the domain's age doesn't count for this page
